Dolly Parton rejected $7 million film offer, role later played by Faye Dunaway

Singer and actress Dolly Parton once declined a film offer worth USD 7 million, stating it was not her "real nature." The role was later portrayed by Faye Dunaway in the 1984 superhero movie "Supergirl." The Times of India reported that Parton, a prominent figure in the entertainment industry, had dabbled in film multiple times throughout her career. Times Now also noted the role, and mentioned that another actress was originally considered for the villainous part in the 1984 film.
